name: Wreath
description: Scalloped rings — a lobed outer edge with the middle bored clean out.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { width: 92%; height: 92%; margin: 4%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); @shape: bud 8; -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 54%, #000 54%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 54%, #000 54%); -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 45deg, 90deg, 135deg, 180deg, 225deg, 270deg, 315deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 45deg, 90deg, 135deg, 180deg, 225deg, 270deg, 315deg)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
